title: Account Settings
description: Manage and update your account information, including your email address, preferences, and security settings.

personal_info.title: Personal Information
personal_info.description: Manage and update your personal information to keep your profile complete, accurate, and up to date.

security.title: Security
security.description: Manage your account security and update your password to protect your information.

forgot_password.title: External reset
forgot_password.description: To use this option, you will be logged out in order to reset your password via email. Do you wish to continue?

danger_zone.title: Danger zone
danger_zone.description: Manage your account status. You can activate or deactivate your account at any time.

status.title: Account status
status.description: Activate or deactivate your account as needed.

dialog.title: Change account status
dialog.description: Are you sure you want to {{action}} your account? This action will affect access to your data.

delete.title: Delete account
delete.description: Permanently delete your account and all your data. This action is irreversible.

dialog.title: Irreversible deletion
dialog.description: Warning! You are about to permanently delete your account. This action cannot be undone.
